description: Input event sequence for Kotoba TTS v1.8 (promptless, one-shot) bidirectional streaming

events._comment: Step 1: Configure session (must be the first client message, sent within WS_OPEN_TIMEOUT = 10s). `speaker_id` selects one of the available voice presets (see session_config.speaker_id_examples below). `default` is always available. `format` and `sample_rate` are optional and select the output audio encoding (see output_audio_format_specs below); both default to float32 @ 24000 Hz. The negotiated values are echoed on session.created.

Step 2: Submit a synthesis turn. v1.0 is one-shot: the full `text` is sent inside `response.create`. There is no input_text_buffer.append / input_text_buffer.commit. `response_id` is optional (server generates a UUID when omitted) and is echoed on every response-scoped server event. `with_timestamps` is optional and defaults to false; true requests incremental audio.chunk.alignments. `voice_settings.speed` is optional (0.7-1.5, default 1.0) and sets the speaking rate without changing the pitch.
events.text: こんにちは、世界。今日もよろしくお願いします。

session_config._speaker_id_note: `default` and `man-1` are the same male voice; `woman-1` is a female voice. Unknown ids fail with response.done {status: failed, error.code: unknown_speaker_id}.

response_create_fields.text: Required, non-empty string. The full text to synthesize.
response_create_fields.response_id: Optional string. Echoed back on response.created / audio.chunk / response.done. Defaults to a server-generated UUID.
response_create_fields.with_timestamps: Optional boolean, default false. When true, audio chunks stream newly finalized alignments.
response_create_fields.voice_settings: Optional object. `speed` is a number from 0.7 to 1.5 (default 1.0); 1.5 is 1.5x faster. An invalid value is rejected with a non-fatal error carrying the response_id.

cancel._comment: Send to cancel the currently active response. The server replies with response.done (status=cancelled) within WS_CANCEL_GRACE_TIMEOUT.

output_audio_format_specs._format_note: Optional `format`/`sample_rate` on the open event select the output encoding (default float32 @ 24000 Hz). PCM formats (float32, pcm16) accept any sample_rate_options value. mulaw is always 8000 Hz and opus is always 24000 Hz; a requested sample_rate is ignored for those. An unsupported format or sample_rate fails the open with an error and closes the connection. The former spellings pcm_f32 and pcm_16 are still accepted as aliases of float32 and pcm16.
